scope: Bounded source-clause audit of 6.1–6.20P, visually checked on Physics specification PDF pages 29–30 / printed 23–24. Diagrams are original schematics, not evidence of completed drawing/practical assessment.
identifierPolicy: Requirement suffixes r1, r2, etc. are local editorial audit identifiers; only the parent reference is publisher-numbered.

parents.scopeNote: All three named units are tracked.

requirements.summary: Use amperes for current.
remainingChecks: Validate input/output currents and unit prefixes.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use volts for potential difference.
remainingChecks: Validate input/output voltage and turns-ratio interpretation.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use watts for power.
remainingChecks: Distinguish input/output power and energy; validate W/kW conversion.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Attraction/repulsion of magnets is distinct from attraction of unmagnetised magnetic materials.

requirements.summary: Describe forces between magnetic poles.
remainingChecks: Validate all like/unlike pole arrangements.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Recognise attraction of magnetic substances.
remainingChecks: Validate why attraction alone does not prove permanent magnetism.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Hard/soft refers to magnetic retention and ease of magnetisation.

requirements.summary: Describe magnetically hard and soft materials.
remainingChecks: Assess both material types and their uses without confusing physical hardness.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Field lines represent local resultant field direction.

requirements.summary: Explain a magnetic field line.
remainingChecks: Validate compass tangents, arrow direction, strength spacing and non-crossing patterns.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Induction here means induced magnetisation, not induced voltage.

requirements.summary: Explain magnetisation induced by an external magnetic field.
remainingChecks: Calibrate near/far induced poles and retention in hard/soft materials.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Both one bar magnet and a pair of bar magnets are explicit practical contexts.

requirements.summary: Investigate a permanent bar magnet’s field pattern.
remainingChecks: Validate compass mapping and directed lines from actual/independent observations.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Investigate the field between two bar magnets.
remainingChecks: Validate unlike and like facing poles, including qualitative central weak-field behaviour.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The approximately uniform region is the central gap between suitable unlike pole faces.

requirements.summary: Use two permanent magnets to produce a uniform field pattern.
remainingChecks: Validate arrangements and learner-drawn parallel/equally spaced lines with edge limitations.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Current creates a field around the conductor, not only when a second magnet is present.

requirements.summary: Recognise the magnetic field around a current-carrying conductor.
remainingChecks: Validate on/off and reversal observations without claiming the field is an electric field.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Paper 2 construction requirement.

requirements.summary: Describe electromagnet construction.
remainingChecks: Validate insulated winding, controlled supply and suitable soft core in a labelled construction task.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Three drawings are explicitly required; supplied schematics support teaching but do not establish drawing competence.

requirements.summary: Draw a straight current-carrying wire’s magnetic field.
remainingChecks: Assess end-on circles, tangent arrows and current dot/cross reversal.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Draw a flat circular coil’s field.
remainingChecks: Assess both edge-on and face-on interpretation with closed return lines.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Draw a current-carrying solenoid’s field.
remainingChecks: Validate interior/exterior directions, poles and uniform-interior limits.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Paper 2 charged-particle force; parallel includes the opposite along-field direction.

requirements.summary: Recognise magnetic force on a moving charge whose motion is not parallel to the field.
remainingChecks: Validate stationary, parallel, antiparallel and cross-field cases; distinguish positive and negative charges.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Cause of force and both applications are source demands.

requirements.summary: Explain the force on a current-carrying wire in a magnetic field.
remainingChecks: Assess moving-charge/field interaction and external-field conditions.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Explain a simple d.c. motor.
remainingChecks: Validate coil forces, turning effects, brushes and correctly timed split-ring reversal.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Explain a loudspeaker.
remainingChecks: Validate varying current, varying force, cone vibration and pressure variations.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The source specifies current perpendicular to the field for direction predictions.

requirements.summary: Use the left-hand rule for wire-force direction.
remainingChecks: Calibrate all three-dimensional direction combinations, including into/out-of-page conventions.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Magnitude and direction changes of field/current are explicitly included.

requirements.summary: Describe changes in force magnitude with current and field strength.
remainingChecks: Assess controlled active length/angle and stronger-current/field comparisons.

requirements.summary: Describe force direction changes when field or current reverses.
remainingChecks: Validate each single reversal and both reversals.

parents.scopeNote: Moving conductor or changing field plus voltage-size factors are explicit.

requirements.summary: Recognise induced voltage from suitable motion or a changing field through a coil.
remainingChecks: Validate conductor motion and stationary-coil/changing-field cases; separate open-circuit voltage from current.

requirements.summary: Describe factors affecting induced voltage size.
remainingChecks: Assess rate of change, strength and linked turns without accepting irrelevant motion.

parents.scopeNote: Both rotating-magnet and rotating-coil arrangements plus factors are explicit.

requirements.summary: Describe generation using a rotating magnet inside a coil.
remainingChecks: Validate changing field linkage and mechanical energy input.

requirements.summary: Describe generation using a rotating coil in a field.
remainingChecks: Validate alternating output and slip-ring connection, distinguishing the motor commutator.

requirements.summary: Describe factors affecting generator voltage.
remainingChecks: Calibrate amplitude versus frequency changes from speed, field and turn count.

parents.scopeNote: Paper 2 structure and alternating-voltage change by turns are both required.

requirements.summary: Describe transformer structure.
remainingChecks: Validate primary/secondary insulation and magnetic coupling.

requirements.summary: Explain changed alternating voltage through differing turn counts.
remainingChecks: Validate step-up/step-down and lack of sustained steady-d.c. operation.

parents.scopeNote: Paper 2 large-scale generation/transmission application.

requirements.summary: Explain step-up and step-down transformers in transmission.
remainingChecks: Assess same-power lower-current reasoning and I²R loss without claiming zero resistance/loss.

parents.scopeNote: Know/use local subdivisions retain primary/secondary ratio consistency.

remainingChecks: Validate recall with matching numerator/denominator quantities.

requirements.summary: Use the voltage/turns ratio.
